description: Test a regular expression against text and see every match: the matched substring, its index, and all capture groups. Deterministic — the same pattern and text always produce the same result, unlike LLM-simulated regex matching. Use this when an agent needs to pattern + text → every match, group and index. x402 price $0.01/call (USDC, eip155:8453).
name: dev_regex_tester
title: Regex Tester
